gloss: wordplay; word game; play on words

definitions.gloss: wordplay; word game; play on words
definitions.explanation: Creative or humorous use of language for amusement, including puns, riddles, rhymes, and other linguistic games.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言葉遊|ことばあそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I had fun playing word games with the children.

examples.japanese: しりとり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な{言葉遊|ことばあそ}びだ。
examples.english: Shiritori is a representative Japanese word game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧な{言葉遊|ことばあそ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれていて→含む：01982_fukumu⟧、⟦{聞|き}き{取|と}る→聞き取る：04583_kikitoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Rakugo contains a lot of clever wordplay, which can sometimes be difficult to catch.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (words) + ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧ (play). Covers a wide range of linguistic play, from children's games like しりとり (word chain) and なぞなぞ (riddles) to sophisticated literary puns and {掛|か}け⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (double-meaning words) in poetry and comedy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言葉遊|ことばあそ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — do wordplay, play word games
- {言葉遊|ことばあそ}び⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ — like wordplay
- ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧な{言葉遊|ことばあそ}び — clever wordplay
- {言葉遊|ことばあそ}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん} — word game book

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{駄洒落|だじゃれ}→駄洒落：10148_dajare⟧ — pun, bad joke; a specific type of wordplay, often groan-inducing
- {掛|か}け⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ — double entendre, pivot word; a classical rhetorical technique using words with double meanings
- {地口|じぐち} — a type of pun based on similar-sounding phrases; more literary and traditional
